headline: Bernstein Reports Samsung Overtook SK Hynix in HBM Revenue for Q3 2026
summary: According to Bernstein, Samsung surpassed SK Hynix in high-bandwidth memory (HBM) revenue during the third quarter of 2026.
why: HBM chips are critical components for high-performance processors powering artificial intelligence infrastructure and data centers.

impacts.name: Samsung Electronics
impacts.why: Gaining revenue share in the lucrative HBM market strengthens Samsung's semiconductor division position.

impacts.name: SK Hynix
impacts.why: Ceding top revenue position in HBM to a major rival indicates heightened competition in advanced memory.
